bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Lake County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; LAKE COUNTY. +]

[+$25,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the director of the Minnesota State Arts Board for a grant to Lake County for a woodworking program to provide materials and intergenerational programming in the arts with a focus on seniors. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Lake County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LAKE COUNTY.

$25,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the director of the Minnesota State Arts Board for a grant to Lake County for a woodworking program to provide materials and intergenerational programming in the arts with a focus on seniors.
additions: $25,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the director of the Minnesota State Arts Board for a grant to Lake County for a woodworking program to provide materials and intergenerational programming in the arts with a focus on seniors.
